I had two crowns fitted in November 2016 and they are still perfect. One of them was particularly difficult as most of the tooth had broken. I was cautioned that there may be issues with fitting a crown but it worked out fine. A surgeon from the hospital was called in to assist with the difficult tooth at very little extra cost.
The dentist gained her qualifications in the USA. Her English is OK, just talk clearly and slow and be prepared for a little sign language. The cost was a tenth what I would pay in New Zealand and a quarter what I was quoted at one of Chiang Mai's tourist dental clinics. The tourist dental place looked like a good option as well but a bit of a production line with lots of dental chairs lined up, but a  good place to get x-rays done if you need them.

It was a very bad experience, the dentist's skill was too bad, and they kept chatting without considering the pain of the client. It was just a simple tooth wash, and I felt that I bleed 50ml of blood. I experienced very painful a day.
I just had a cleaning and assessment as I was leaving town. Great English, thorough, efficient,  no waiting, next day appointment, clean and a bargain compared to U.S.A.. I would definitely return.

While in Chiang Mai, I developed a toothache from an untreated toothache and my cheek became swollen. I was already thinking my vacation was ruined and I'd have to return home early. Then I went to this dental clinic, where the doctor prescribed antibiotics. I couldn't treat the tooth because I was flying to another city the next day. After two days of treatment, the tooth stopped hurting. Eighteen days after returning home, my tooth was treated and everything is fine. Thanks to the doctor at this clinic.

I went to the dentist last week. A male dentist worked on my gums, and it was incredibly painful. When I got home, my gums were swollen and I couldn't eat for a week now, and it's still not better. It's been 9 days already. I have to use mouthwash constantly and take anti-inflammatory and pain medication because the pharmacy said it was gingivitis and I needed to clean my teeth regularly. It was awful. Last year, a female dentist worked on my teeth for 9500 baht, including fillings, and she did a great job. This year, even for just a scaling, it was a male dentist, and it was terrible. I will never go back there again.
Based on my experience getting dental work done here, I feel that the root canal specialist and the orthodontist, overall, do a very good job.
The doctor provided excellent care, and the price was very reasonable. I'll definitely come back again! 🥰 …
